title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Rate Card — Seasoning Points for Long-Held Accounts and ProBuild Memberships
content:
**Clause.** On a Ridgeline Pro Credit credit line increase, seasoning points are added to the increase percentage before it is applied: the line increase is worked as the current credit line times the sum of the increase percentage and the seasoning points, divided by one hundred. The seasoning points are set by the ages of the account and of the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership, both in whole calendar months to the decision date:

| Account open | ProBuild membership enrolled | Seasoning points |
|---|---|---|
| At least 84 whole months | At least 60 whole months | 5 (top seasoning points) |
| At least 36 whole months | At least 24 whole months, the first condition not met | 2.5 (middle seasoning points) |
| Any other combination | | 0 |

The account's age runs from its opening date; the membership's age runs from the enrollment date of the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership in active status. A business with no active membership earns no seasoning points.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Account open | Membership enrolled | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 90 months | 66 months | 5 |
| 90 months | 50 months | 2.5 |
| 84 months | 59 months | 2.5 |
| 35 months | 120 months | 0 |
| 40 months | 23 months | 0 |

Hypothetical example: a current line of 20000.00 with an increase percentage of 25 and 2.5 seasoning points works the line increase at 27.5 percent, that is 5500.00.
